title: AGM Minutes — March 2025
description: Annual General Meeting March 2025. Election of 2025 office bearers: President Alecia Nealon, VP Dave Gurr, Secretary Imke Pearce, Treasurer Laura Butler. Constitutional changes including removal of Wellbeing Officer role and addition of Newsletter Coordinator. Annual financial reports accepted.

title: Meeting Minutes — March 2025
description: Monthly meeting March 2025. 2025 events calendar established with 8 major events. Canteen ran at a loss in 2024 — separate meeting to discuss pricing and menu. School uniform upgrade underway with Lowes. P&C no longer part of Healthy School Canteens program.

title: Meeting Minutes — April 2025
description: Monthly meeting April 2025. P&C property insurance corrected. Canteen now running at small profit after pricing changes. Teacher class gifts approved $350 per class. New canteen safety procedures and daily timeline being developed. Grant discussion: shade cloth, playground, oval line marking.

title: Meeting Minutes — May 2025
description: Monthly meeting May 2025. Election Day profit $2,514.82 from BBQ and Cake Stall. Canteen needs $550/week to break even. Artificial turf blacklisted due to carcinogens — pivot to modular sports flooring on concrete slab. Uniform skort design chosen. Mothers Day stall and Picnic planning.

title: Meeting Minutes — August 2025
description: Monthly meeting August 2025. $80K grant application submitted for basketball court upgrade and modular flooring. Canteen shutters complicated by asbestos — ASSETS advises wall lining hazardous, adds ~$5K, requires health regulator supervision. Gittoes to donate $2,000 towards shutters. Canteen Admin/Manager role proposed for next AGM. Community Building Grant via Adam Crouch — deadline 15 December.

title: Meeting Minutes — September 2025
description: Monthly meeting September 2025. Sculptures in the Vines event planned — Holgate P&C running cake stall and craft station over October long weekend. P&C voted NOT to proceed with canteen shutters now — will include in future grant submission due to high costs. Senior jackets: last year. Still awaiting $80K grant result.

title: Meeting Minutes — November 2025
description: Monthly meeting November 2025. Bottom area playground: $27,800 quote accepted (Scotty), school contributing $10K. Community Building Grant targeting $20K for canteen shutters. Canteen freezer failure — insurance claim being prepared. Trivia Night: silent auction more profitable than raffles. Starlink Mini proposed for Wi-Fi at events. Policy folder review assigned to CB, VCR, SS.

title: Commercial Endorsement and Sponsorship Policy
description: Holgate Public School P&C Association Commercial Endorsement and Sponsorship Policy. Sets out the framework for accepting sponsorships and commercial endorsements, including approval authority, acknowledgement benefits, and conditions for trial periods.

title: Community Building Grant Strategy — Canteen Shutters & Asbestos
description: Full grant strategy for the Community Building Partnership grant application targeting ~$20K for canteen shutter replacement and asbestos removal. Includes Q38-41 narrative responses, evidence checklist, task assignments, community impact framing, and key contacts. Canteen framed as the community hub for this semi-rural area with no public transport or gathering spaces.

title: Starlink Mini Connectivity Proposal
description: P&C meeting proposal for a Starlink Mini satellite internet service to improve connectivity at school events including Trivia Night. Covers the problem of unreliable Wi-Fi, proposed solution, costs (~$199 hardware + $60/month), funding approach via local business sponsorship, and formal motion block for P&C approval.
